features.feature: Scientific mode (powers, roots, logs, trig, hyperbolic, factorial, e, pi, EE, Rand)

features.apple: Localizable: 2nd / Alternate Functions, Secondary Functions (or hold Shift)
features.note: 2nd key works; holding Shift does not switch the keypad. The shell sends no modifier state to apps (a held Shift is never an input event), so the held-Shift switch needs an SDK input addition first.
features.wire: Add a modifier-state input to the SDK app protocol, then treat a held Shift as Act::Second while it is down and redraw the keypad labels.

features.feature: Programmer mode (hex/dec/oct/bin bases, bitwise AND/OR/XOR/NOR/NOT, shifts, rotate, byte/word flip, 2's complement, binary view, ASCII/Unicode display)
features.apple: Localizable: Programmer, Hexadecimal, Bitwise …, Shift Left/Right, Rotate, Byte Flip, Word Flip, Show Binary, ASCII value, Unicode value
features.note: Programmer segment in the toolbar and View menu: 8/16/32/64-bit word, BIN/OCT/DEC/HEX, A-F and 00/FF keys, AND/OR/XOR/NOR/NOT, <<, >>, X<<Y, X>>Y, RoL, RoR, byte flip, word flip, 2's complement, a clickable binary row and a Unicode readout; hex digits and & | ^ ~ < > from the keyboard (calc.rs:183, calc.rs:1515); built on parity/team-d-calculator; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Compare the keypad layout, the binary row and the signed/unsigned display with the reference on Midget; add grouping of the binary digits.

features.feature: RPN mode (enter, drop, swap, roll up/down, stack display)
features.apple: Localizable: RPN Mode On/Off, Enter, Drop, Swap, Rotate stack up/down
features.note: View > RPN Mode puts the basic keypad on a stack: Enter replaces =, Stack menu has Swap (cmd+E), Drop, Roll Up and Roll Down, the stack under X shows above the display (calc.rs:974); the shell only dispatches character key equivalents, so cmd+Delete and cmd+Up/Down work from the menu; built on parity/team-d-calculator; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify on Midget; route non-character key equivalents (Delete, Up, Down) through the shell menu once it supports them.

features.apple: Localizable: Unit Conversion, Category, Input Unit, Result Unit, Swap Units, Recent Units, Search all units
features.note: Thirteen categories now: length, mass, temperature, speed, volume, area, time, data size, energy, pressure, power, angle and fuel economy (two segment rows, calc.rs:79); no unit search or recent-units list yet; built on parity/team-d-calculator; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add a search field over all units and a recent-units list stored in settings.

features.wire: Draw full section headers between day groups instead of a caption inside the first row.
